title: First nations to launch satellites
subtitle: Year of first own-rocket launch
hook: Which country was first in orbit? Can you guess #1?
fact: Japan's first satellite, Ohsumi (24 kg), launched in 1970 and stayed in orbit for 33 years, until 2003.
